gap_details.2011-2012: LOW (phase 2). Still no residents roster, but the neurosurgery.umc.edu faculty page (Wayback 2011-07-20, 2011-09-30, 2012-02-06) lists Bryan Gaspard and Jared J. Marks as 'Instructor' = PGY7 transitional year (both PGY VI 2010-11; handbook 2011-12 says the PGY7 resident is credentialed as Instructor); loaded as an 'other' capture. Reconstructed: Rey-Dios (PGY6), Orozco-Castillo (PGY5), Johnson, Stacy, Uribe, Burnsed, Luqman. Not reconstructed: interns Perez and Tawfik (first seen PGY3 2013-14; NPPES NPIs issued July 2011).
gap_details.2012-2013: LOW (phase 2). No roster. Reconstructed Rey-Dios (PGY7; UMMC papers 2013; Assistant Professor by Mar 2014) and Orozco-Castillo (PGY6; bracketed by Instructor 2013-14) in addition to phase-1 rows. May-2013 faculty page (Wayback and CC-MAIN-2013-20) shows no Instructor. Hidalgo (PGY1; NPI July 2012) not reconstructed.
gap_details.2013-2014: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-48 (2013-12-09) Ektron roster, 10 names, PGY VI empty (Orozco-Castillo, PGY IV in 2010-11, would have been PGY VII here and is absent; no one expected at PGY VI). Phase 2: Orozco-Castillo is not missing: the Ektron faculty page (CC-MAIN-2014-10, 2014-15) lists him as Instructor (PGY7) in Mar-Apr 2014; loaded as an 'other' capture. Johnson appears as Instructor Aug-Sep 2014 after his PGY VII listing, probably a short post-graduation appointment or an extension.
gap_details.2014-2015: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2014-49 (2014-11-23); identical content Aug 2014 - Jul 2015. 10 names, no PGY VII (none expected).
gap_details.2015-2016: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2015-48 (2015-11-29); complete 12 names PGY I-VII.
gap_details.2016-2017: LOW (phase 2). Still no roster. Ektron faculty page Jul 2016 (CC-MAIN-2016-30) and SOM faculty page Aug-Dec 2017 list no Instructors. Burnsed and Luqman (PGY7) are on a UMMC Batson Children's paper received Dec 2016 (PMID 28251324); Luqman is Wayne State faculty by Jan 2018. Tawfik has a UMMC affiliation June 2016. Remaining risk is a hypothetical second 2016 intern who left before Sep 2017.
gap_details.2017-2018: Not significant (phase 2). The missing PGY VII heading is by design: the PGY7 year is an Instructor or fellowship year (residency overview on the same site, CC 2017-10). Perez (Stanford pediatric neurosurgery by Oct 2018) and Tawfik (Swedish Neuroscience Institute from Nov 2017, the fellowship option) are recorded as completing 2018.
gap_details.2018-2019: Not significant (phase 2). No PGY VII by design. Hidalgo's UMMC faculty profile: University of Mississippi Neurological Surgery 2018, Pediatric Neurosurgery fellowship 2019, ABNS certified; recorded as completing 2019.
gap_details.2020-2021: Not significant (phase 2). Smalley omitted, then back as PGY VI in May 2022; now UMMC Assistant Professor.
gap_details.2021-2022: Wayback 2021-10-26 (10 names, Smalley still omitted) plus a partial 'other' snapshot from 2022-05-19 carrying only Smalley (PGY VI). The May 2022 capture also drops A. Smith (PGY VII), probably an early finish or a page edit.

joiners_note: No one appears above PGY-1 in a year whose preceding roster exists and lacks them. Hidalgo (first seen PGY2 2013-14) and Perez/Tawfik (first seen PGY3 2013-14) first appear after the 2011-13 gap, so they are not classified as joiners. Smalley (first seen PGY2 2017-18) first appears after the 2016-17 gap. All entry years are consistent.

adjudication_summary.note: Phase 2 added Gaspard, Marks, Rey-Dios, Orozco-Castillo (in the program in 2011-12) and 8 training_history rows.

problems: All six phase-1 failed Common Crawl fetches retried in phase 2 and succeeded (phase2/ccretry_log.txt): nothing new (CC-MAIN-2018-47 SOM roster = 2018-19 content). The two Resident_Manual.pdf CC records (2018-08, 2019-09) are truncated and unparseable. OpenAlex returned 429 and was not used; Europe PMC gave one 503 and succeeded on retry.
pgy7_note: Handbooks 2009-10 and 2011-12 and the 2017-19 residency overview: 7-year program; the PGY7 year is either transitional training at UMMC with the resident credentialed as 'Instructor in Neurosurgery', or a subspecialty fellowship. PGY7s therefore appear on the FACULTY page as Instructors (Gaspard and Marks 2011-12; Orozco-Castillo 2013-14; Johnson Aug-Sep 2014) or not at all, and the 2017-18 and 2018-19 residents pages have no PGY VII heading for that reason.

2011-2012.reason: PGY7s observed as Instructors on the faculty page (Gaspard, Marks); PGY2-6 bracketed and reconstructed (incl. Rey-Dios, Orozco-Castillo, backed by UMMC-affiliated papers); 2 interns (Perez, Tawfik, NPIs issued July 2011) first seen PGY3 2013-14, matching the alternating 2/1 intake.

2012-2013.reason: All PGY2-7 bracketed (Rey-Dios PGY7 -> faculty 2014; Orozco-Castillo -> Instructor 2013-14); sole 2012 intern Hidalgo (NPI July 2012) first seen PGY2 2013-14; intake pattern leaves no unexplained slot.

2013-2014.reason: Ektron roster (CC) plus faculty page showing Orozco-Castillo as PGY7 Instructor.

2016-2017.reason: No roster, but PGY2-5 bracketed; PGY7 Burnsed and Luqman shown in program by a Dec 2016 UMMC paper and then graduate (Luqman Wayne State faculty Jan 2018); PGY6 Perez/Tawfik bracketed by later completion evidence; only residual risk is an unseen second 2016 intern, but 2016 was a 1-intern year in the 2/1 pattern.

2017-2018.reason: PGY I-VI complete; PGY VII omitted by design (instructor/fellowship year). Perez and Tawfik completion recorded from later affiliations.

2018-2019.reason: PGY I-VI complete; PGY7 Hidalgo confirmed by his UMMC faculty bio (residency 2018 + pediatric fellowship 2019).

2020-2021.reason: Smalley omitted from the page but returned as PGY VI in May 2022 and is now UMMC faculty; no one else missing.

2021-2022.reason: Complete except the known Smalley omission; A. Smith's May-2022 removal was graduation (faculty bio: residency 2022).
